name: discover-accounts-outreach-quality
description: Quality gate on outreach angles produced during discovery — should be specific to the found signals, not generic.

businessContext.overview: SOC2 compliance automation for scaling SaaS.

icp.title: Head of Engineering at Series B-D SaaS
icp.description: Post-PMF SaaS companies preparing for enterprise sales.

expectations.rubric: A great outreach angle references the specific signals detected for THIS account (e.g. 'referenced their first Head of Security hire mentioned in the Feb blog post'). Generic value-prop restatements ('we help SaaS achieve SOC2 faster') score low.
